retrievalProfile.description: A high-key winter scene featuring a classic snowman with layered serif and script typography for a festive, traditional holiday aesthetic.
triggerTerms: snowman with top hat and scarf
layered script and serif holiday text

recipe.visualDefinition: A bright, high-key photograph of a snowman positioned in the upper right quadrant, featuring a black top hat, carrot nose, and striped scarf, set against a white snowy background with large, layered festive typography in the foreground.
coreVisualRelationships: Snowman character anchored in the top right
Large script text overlapping smaller serif text in the lower half
High-key white background blending into the snow texture
Red accent color in text contrasting with the cool blue-white environment
coreInvariants: Snowman with traditional coal-like features and a carrot nose
Two-tier typographic hierarchy with overlapping script and serif styles

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Snowman is medium-scale, located in the upper right; typography is large-scale, dominating the bottom half.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large red script word in the lower center acts as the primary visual anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the snowman's face, move down the scarf to the large red script, then read the secondary serif text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Extensive white negative space on the left side and top edge creates a clean, airy feel.

colorSystem.accentColorRole: Bright Red (primary script text) and Orange (carrot nose)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value (brightness) throughout with high saturation only in the red text and orange nose.
paletteRestrictions: Limit to white, cool grays, black, and one primary warm accent color.

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.baseSkeleton: Combination of a traditional transitional serif and a fluid, formal copperplate-style script.
letterConstructionRules: Serif text uses all-caps with high stroke contrast and sharp serifs.
Script text features long, sweeping ascenders and descenders with variable line weight.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The script 'S' and 'n' have extended flourishes to frame the serif text.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: High-contrast pairing of a structured, formal serif with a decorative, expressive script.
graphicDevices: Drop shadows to separate text from the white background
Layering of text elements to create depth

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the formal, flourishing nature of the red script.
Provides the traditional, high-contrast serif look for the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key photograph of a snowman in the upper right corner with a black top hat, carrot nose, and striped scarf against a bright white snowy field.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large red script text in the lower center. Overlay white all-caps serif text with a thin gray outline across the middle-bottom, partially overlapping the script.

verificationChecks: Is the snowman in the upper right?
Is the background predominantly white and high-key?
Does the red script text sit behind the white serif text?
Is the serif text in all caps?

adjustableVariables: Accent color of the script text
Specific wording of the holiday message
postGenerationChecks: Check for clean negative space on the left
recipe.reuseFormula: High-key winter photography + [Subject: Snowman/Reindeer/Tree] in top right + [Layer 1: Large Red Script] + [Layer 2: Overlapping White All-Caps Serif]
